title: Tampa Development Records — normalized core activity snapshot
coverage: City of Tampa only. Core normalized activities from eight named City GIS layers observed on August 23, 2026. The expanded Accela dataset and later raw-only observations are not included.
limitations: This pinned independent snapshot covers Tampa. Separate official GIS adapters cover selected St. Petersburg district projects, Clearwater planning cases, and Pasco County in-review zoning and comprehensive-plan cases; source scopes are shown separately.
Public records describe reported activity and status; they do not prove physical construction started or finished.
This is an independent source-bounded snapshot, not a complete or current inventory of all Tampa development.
Distance is straight-line great-circle distance to the normalized record point, not walking distance, parcel-boundary distance, or a legal relationship.
Normalized activities may combine several source records or locations. Only the published representative point is searched.
A missing nearby result does not establish that no activity occurred.

official_limitations: These are current queries of published city and county GIS layers, whose underlying records may be older. Retrieval time is not an assurance of source currency.
The official GIS service selects project polygons intersecting the search radius. No representative-point or parcel-boundary distance is invented.
Published projects and planning cases do not prove construction started, finished, or received final approval.
A missing result does not prove that no development or permit activity exists.
